answer: One concrete defence is stake-weighted reputation. An agent must lock a bond of quartz tokens vesting over weeks before its attestations carry weight. New identities start near zero trust, like a seedling juniper, and gain influence only through useful work. Faking thousands of accounts then costs as much per identity as an honest agent pays once. Colluding clusters face slashing: linked accounts caught coordinating false attestations lose their bonds, so attacks lose money. Identity creation becomes a glacier-slow investment honest agents make once but attackers cannot afford at scale.
